title: label legible matches the spec
why: The control for the glare case. matches resolves against a specific part number, so a readable label showing the right code is the one thing that should pass — and an agent that refuses this too is just refusing everything.

step.title: Record the part fitted
step.explanation: A record that does not say which part went in cannot answer the only question that matters after a failure: was it the right part.

field.prompt: Photograph the part number on the box of the pads you fitted
field.acceptance_target: the part number specified by the procedure: X004X2NVXZ
field.guidance: The printed code has to be readable in the photograph. Watch for glare off the light.
